title.zh: 复数 · 平面上的旋转
title.en: Complex Numbers · Rotation on the Plane

desc.zh: 复数不是硬凑出来的数：a+bi 就是平面上的一个点。乘以 i，是把这个点逆时针转 90°；一般的乘法是模相乘、角相加。代数算一遍、几何看一遍，两条路永远同一个答案。
desc.en: A complex number is not an invented patch: a+bi is a point on the plane. Multiplying by i rotates that point 90° counterclockwise; multiplication in general multiplies the moduli and adds the angles. Compute it algebraically, watch it geometrically — both roads always land on the same answer.
